notes.title: Update for Mac OS X 10.13 and later.
notes.content: Make Mac OS X 10.13 build the default. Should resolve "damaged and can't be opened" issue on recent Mac OS X.

tags.bug: Make Mac OS X 10.13 build the default. Should resolve "damaged and can't be opened" issue on recent Mac OS X.

notes.title: DEFCON Update Released for MacOS
notes.content:
• Fixed : Crash on startup reported on some Macs with Radeon gfx and Mac OSX 10.7
  • Fixed : Mac trackpad now behaves properly, ie same as scrolling the mouse wheel to zoom.
  • Updated SDL to 1.2.13 (to fix trackpad problems)
